start_new: 👋 Hi, {name}! Most people notice emotional burnout too late. 🧠 MindCheck helps you track: — anxiety — stress — sleep — mood — energy level 📊 The longer you use the bot, the more accurately you see your emotional patterns. 🤖 AI will explain test results in plain language. ⚠️ The bot does not diagnose and does not replace a specialist. ℹ️ Full list of features — use /help. Let's start with a short test 👇

help: 📌 Where to start: 1️⃣ Take any test — you'll get your current result with an AI explanation. 2️⃣ Check in every day — it takes 1 minute. 3️⃣ After 3-5 check-ins, open 🔍 Insights — personal observations will appear. 4️⃣ 📊 History and 📈 Chart show how your condition changes over time. 📋 All features: 🧪 Take a test — PHQ-9, GAD-7, Burnout, Self-esteem, EQ. You can retake tests to track changes over time. ✅ Check-in — 5 short questions: mood, anxiety, energy, sleep. 📊 My history — your last 10 test results. 📈 Chart — test and check-in dynamics over the last 7 days. 🔍 Insights — connections between sleep, mood and anxiety based on your data (available from 3 check-ins). 📅 Calendar — your mood over 30 days at a glance. 💬 Feedback — rate the bot and leave a comment, it genuinely helps improve it. ⚙️ Commands: /reminder — change the check-in reminder time /language — change the bot's language /help — show this message again ⚠️ The bot does not diagnose and does not replace a doctor. If a test result worries you, please consult a specialist.
